hooks.name: catalog-or-schema-changed
hooks.description: Keep catalog, schema, steering, power references, specs and golden example aligned.

action.prompt: The LiveArch catalog or model schema changed. Before finishing: (1) run `python3 power/livearch/skills/architecture-diagrams/scripts/validate_architecture.py --catalog` and fix every error; (2) bump `catalogVersion` (patch = mapping fix, minor = new types, major = removed/renamed kinds) and the same value in the golden example model; (3) if kinds, edge kinds or ID rules changed, update `.kiro/steering/architecture-model.md`, `.kiro/steering/diagram-conventions.md` and `power/livearch/skills/architecture-diagrams/references/model-building.md` so they say the same thing; (4) re-render the golden example with scripts/render.py; (5) if behaviour changed, add or update the acceptance criteria in the affected spec (MOD or REN) and its tasks. Use the add-resource-mapping skill for new resource types.

hooks.name: design-rules-changed
hooks.description: Design steering and the Power's operational reference must not drift apart.

action.prompt: A LiveArch rule document changed. The design steering (.kiro/steering/architecture-model.md, iac-sources.md, diagram-conventions.md) and the Power's operational references (power/livearch/skills/architecture-diagrams/references/*.md) must state the same rules: the steering explains why, the references explain how. Compare the changed section with its counterpart and align the other file. If the change alters behaviour, check that render.py / validate_architecture.py still implement it and that a spec acceptance criterion covers it. List what you aligned in at most 3 lines.

hooks.name: spec-traceability
hooks.description: Every acceptance criterion must be EARS-formed and covered by a task.
